description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.07.2020 to 19.07.2020
categorisation: This gazette content is a Customs Notification that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, exercises powers under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235), and contains statutory instruments that govern compliance requirements for international trade and customs payments.
